baseline.title: Frozen playable Tower build before the transformation pivot

candidate.title: Transformed playable build — not yet produced

currentTransformation.title: Make the complete climb look, feel and play markedly better
currentTransformation.promise: An immediately recognizable leap in fully realized 3D cast, environments, grounded movement, meaningful autonomous action and immersive gameplay.
currentTransformation.nextDecision: Produce one integrated playable experience across ascent, combat and outcome; capture paired normal-speed footage before scoring any improvement.
currentTransformation.rejectedMicroMilestones: A green CI run, an isolated pose fix, a prettier screenshot or an extra UI icon never counts as a Gauntlet win.

scenarios.label: Everyday ascent
scenarios.goal: Natural 3D movement, reading the next platform, authentic route choice

scenarios.label: Danger and encounter
scenarios.goal: Moving hazard, enemy/guardian, readable contact and recovery

scenarios.label: Complete game cycle
scenarios.goal: Milestone, outcome and verified restart/continued ascent

benchmark.fidelity: Returnal — Tower of Sisyphus (materials, cinematic lighting, intensity)

policy: Requires matched real gameplay in all three scenes and 4/5 independent blind critics preferring new game in LOOKS, FEELS and PLAYS; technical checks are vetoes, not quality wins.
